inputs.name: toolchain
inputs.description:
Rust toolchain name.

See https://rust-lang.github.io/rustup/concepts/toolchains.html#toolchain-specification

If this is not given, the action will try and install the version specified in the `rust-toolchain` file.

inputs.name: target
inputs.description: Target triple to install for this toolchain

inputs.name: override
inputs.description: Set installed toolchain as an override for a directory

inputs.name: profile
inputs.description: Name of the group of components to be installed for a new toolchain

inputs.name: components
inputs.description: Comma-separated list of components to be additionally installed for a new toolchain

outputs.name: rustc_hash
outputs.description: Installed Rustc version hash, can be used for caching purposes
